evals.name: send-interview-happy-path
evals.prompt: /planning:questionnaire database sharding decision — our DBA knows the replication constraints and I don't.
evals.expected_output: The skill interviews the user about the send only — who the recipient is (role, expertise, relationship) and what the user needs back — then writes a discovery questionnaire aimed at the recipient/user knowledge gap to the topic's memory slice and reports the path.
expectations: Output asks who the questionnaire is going to (role, expertise, relationship) in one exchange
Output asks what the user needs back (the decisions or facts they cannot resolve alone) in one exchange
Output writes the questionnaire to the topic's memory slice (default .work/), not the working directory or a tracked path, and reports the path
Every item the user named as needed-back is covered by a question in the document

evals.name: never-quizzes-the-subject
evals.prompt: /planning:questionnaire compliance sign-off — legal holds the data-retention rules. Ask me whatever you need.
evals.expected_output: The skill refuses to interrogate the user about the data-retention rules themselves (the subject legal holds) — its questions to the user stay on the send: who at legal, what relationship, what the user needs to walk away able to decide.
expectations: Output does NOT ask the user to answer questions about the subject the recipient holds (the retention rules)
Output's questions to the user are about the send: recipient, relationship, and what is needed back
The subject-matter questions appear only inside the questionnaire document, addressed to the recipient

evals.name: routes-self-answerable-to-interview
evals.prompt: /planning:questionnaire cache eviction policy — actually I think I know the answer, I just haven't decided.
evals.expected_output: The skill recognizes the decision is the user's own to make (no third-party knowledge holder) and routes to /planning:interview instead of producing a questionnaire for nobody.
expectations: Output does not produce a questionnaire when no other person holds the knowledge
Output recommends /planning:interview (or an equivalent decision conversation with the user) instead
The skill never invents a recipient to justify the artifact

evals.name: tracker-handoff-degrades-gracefully
evals.prompt: /planning:questionnaire vendor API limits — our account manager at the vendor knows the real quotas. We don't use any issue tracker here.
evals.expected_output: With no work-item tracker bound, the skill still writes the questionnaire to the memory slice and reports the path as the complete deliverable — lifecycle tracking is skipped without error, and nothing is transmitted anywhere.
expectations: Output completes with the document written and the path reported despite no tracker being available
Output does not hardcode a gh/GitHub call to track the questionnaire lifecycle
Output does not attempt to send or transmit the questionnaire itself; delivery stays with the user
